key_insight: Higher-order unconstrained binary optimization (HUBO) provides a more efficient formulation for complex industrial logistics and scheduling problems compared to traditional QUBO methods.
engineering_relevance: The study addresses practical scalability challenges for quantum optimization in real-world applications within logistics and manufacturing.
method: Formulated three logistics and manufacturing use cases as HUBO problems.
Compared HUBO formulations with QUBO encodings to evaluate qubit requirements and circuit depth.
Used classical solvers for validation and benchmarked small routing instances with quantum optimization.
evidence_signal: The research validated HUBO formulations using classical solvers and simulated bias-field digitized quantum optimization to evaluate performance.
watch_item: HUBO's higher-order interactions increase circuit depth, which may limit its implementation on current quantum hardware.
paper_title: Quantum optimization beyond QUBO for industrial logistics and scheduling
